name: Rust
description: Rust's ownership model, traits, error handling, fearless concurrency and building real tools and services.

nodes.name: Rust basics
nodes.desc: Variables and mutability, scalar types, functions and control flow.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write basic Rust programs using immutable and mutable variables, scalar types, functions and control flow.
topics: Integer, float, bool and char types

nodes.name: Cargo
nodes.desc: Creating projects, building, running and adding crates with Cargo.
nodes.summary: You will be able to create, build and run Rust projects with Cargo and add third-party crates as dependencies.

nodes.name: Enums & match
nodes.desc: Enums with data, Option, pattern matching and if let.
nodes.summary: You will be able to model data with enums, handle absence with Option and destructure values with exhaustive pattern matching.

nodes.name: Ownership
nodes.desc: Stack and heap, moves, copies, and how ownership replaces a garbage collector.
nodes.summary: You will understand how Rust's ownership rules manage memory without a garbage collector through moves, copies and scope-based drops.

nodes.name: Borrowing
nodes.desc: Shared and mutable references and the borrow checker's rules.
nodes.summary: You will be able to pass data by shared and mutable references and satisfy the borrow checker's aliasing rules.
topics: One mutable or many shared borrows

nodes.name: Lifetimes
nodes.desc: Lifetime annotations, elision rules and why references cannot dangle.
nodes.summary: You will be able to annotate lifetimes when the compiler needs them and explain how they prevent dangling references.

nodes.name: Strings & slices
nodes.desc: String vs &str, slices and UTF-8 text.
nodes.summary: You will be able to choose between String and &str, take slices safely and work with UTF-8 text correctly.

nodes.name: Structs & traits
nodes.desc: Structs, impl blocks, traits and trait objects.
nodes.summary: You will be able to define structs with impl blocks, share behaviour through traits and use trait objects for dynamic dispatch.
topics: Derivable traits like Debug and Clone

nodes.name: Generics
nodes.desc: Generic types, trait bounds and monomorphisation.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write generic functions and types with trait bounds and understand how monomorphisation makes them zero-cost.
topics: impl Trait in arguments and returns

nodes.name: Result & errors
nodes.desc: Result, the ? operator, custom error types and when to panic.
nodes.summary: You will be able to handle recoverable errors with Result and the ? operator, define custom error types and decide when to panic.

nodes.name: Iterators & closures
nodes.desc: Closures, the Iterator trait and zero-cost iterator chains.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write closures and compose iterator adaptor chains that compile to efficient loops.

nodes.name: Collections
nodes.desc: Vec, HashMap, HashSet and VecDeque.
nodes.summary: You will be able to store and process data with Vec, HashMap, HashSet and VecDeque and choose the right one.

nodes.name: Box, Rc & RefCell
nodes.desc: Heap allocation with Box, shared ownership with Rc and interior mutability.
nodes.summary: You will be able to allocate on the heap with Box, share ownership with Rc and mutate shared data with RefCell.

nodes.name: Threads & Send/Sync
nodes.desc: Spawning threads, Arc and Mutex, channels and the Send and Sync traits.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write safe multithreaded Rust with threads, Arc, Mutex and channels and explain the Send and Sync traits.
topics: Moving data into threads with move
Arc and Mutex for shared state

nodes.name: Async Rust
nodes.desc: Futures, async/await and running tasks on an async runtime.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write asynchronous Rust with futures and async/await and run tasks on a runtime such as Tokio.

nodes.name: Unsafe & FFI
nodes.desc: Raw pointers, unsafe blocks and calling C code.
nodes.summary: You will be able to use unsafe Rust responsibly with raw pointers and call C code through the foreign function interface.

nodes.name: Modules & crates
nodes.desc: Modules, visibility, workspaces and publishing a crate.
nodes.summary: You will be able to organise code into modules and crates, control visibility, use workspaces and publish to crates.io.

nodes.name: Testing
nodes.desc: Unit, integration and doc tests.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write unit, integration and documentation tests for Rust code and run them with cargo test.

nodes.name: CLI grep project
nodes.desc: Build a fast grep-like command-line tool with tests.
nodes.summary: You will build a fast grep-like command-line tool in Rust with argument parsing, error handling and tests.

nodes.name: Async web service
nodes.desc: Build an async JSON web service with a database pool and graceful error handling.
nodes.summary: You will build an async JSON web service in Rust with a database connection pool and graceful error handling.
